methods.reimplementation_audit_table:
| Component | Paper description | Our v3 reimplementation | Source of choice |
|-----------|-------------------|--------------------------|------------------|
| Per-frame FBP | Standard inverse Radon + ramp filter | Manual rfft/irfft + ramp filter + per-angle rotate | Paper Eqs. |
| Per-frame learnable filter | "Adaptive frequency-domain filter" | MLP f(ω_norm)→R hidden=32, 3 layers | Paper §2 (width ASSUMPTION) |
| Dynamic denoiser | "merges information across all time frames" | 3D U-Net treating T as depth axis (Conv3d) | ASSUMPTION (paper silent) |
| Loss (per-frame MSE) | Per-frame MSE | STUB only (no training) | N/A for handoff |
| Loss (temporal) | Temporal L1 smoothness | STUB only (no training) | N/A for handoff |
| Normalization | BN + LN + GN (paper) | BN3d only | INCOMPLETE |
| Output non-negative | Paper clips post-hoc | ReLU on denoiser output (A4) | N/A |
| Operator | Vendor smat | Our 180-angle, 182-bin ParallelBeam | Per §D |

Explicit ASSUMPTIONs: A1 channel layout, A2 loss stub, A3 MLP width, A4 ReLU for non-neg, A5 rfft FBP, A6 3D-UNet T-as-depth.
